title: Unit Event — Whip Yourself into Shape! — Episode7 What Partners Are

meta.Event Outline: An psyches herself up to work on the task she's been given, but there's hesitation in her singing. When she realizes that her unease over Kohane is causing the problem, An calls her out to Vivid Street to settle things once and for all.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa! Look at this crowd...!
There's gotta be like a hundred people here!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh...!
You're the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff Member
rows.Line:
H-Hey, what's going on?!
Why are those two battling it out?!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: I started hearing some amazing singing out on the street. I couldn't believe it was them!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
This isn't like those two...
Are they having a fight or something...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this is something Shiraishi needs to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so we'd appreciate it if you just sat back and watched.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Looks like we won't be able to leave any time soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(The way her voice pierces my heart...
She's really just like...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The way An's singing...
I can tell she's absolutely determined to win...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is nothing like when we sing together on stage. I've been getting goosebumps just listening to her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The way she sings really has this way of exciting me. It makes me want to sing like her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've learned a lot since meeting her and learning how to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing's a part of my identity now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I've learned how sour defeat can taste.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to lose, even to An!!)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Seriously, how high is her ceiling...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: One could say the same of Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Thanks for throwing everything you have at me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've been hearing you sing for a long time now, but this is easily your best performance yet.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And you get that you need to give me everything you've got, or this battle won't matter...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm really scared about doing this. Even right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Because losing means having to live with this doubt.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(We'll keep singing together...
But I'll be in fear while I do.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which is why... I'm going to win.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (In order to keep standing proud by your side.)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Why's Shiraishi willing to go this far...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okazaki...
Have you ever felt afraid?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's been afraid this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's doing this to overcome that fear.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (When did all these people show up...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
They all came to watch.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was sure they'd all show up if we sang here.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (To be fair, I lost sight of everything else once our battle started.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this is the perfect stage for it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's settle it with this next one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: H-How much higher can she go...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, how does she do it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You just keep finding ways to get better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Even during this battle...
It's both scary and unbelievable how you're able to do that.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's why you make my heart race so much.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You still don't fully understand why you're the best partner I could ever ask for.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You have this way of digging up everything that's been laying dormant inside of me. My doubts, how lame I really am...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I never wanted to face those things, but I'm really glad that I did now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to do the same to you.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I want to draw everything out of you.
Hidden talents, emotions you didn't know you felt... All of it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want my singing to do that!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
That's the best she's done so far today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're not gonna know what to do with yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: You're doing great, An!!! You can win this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I can keep going...!
I'm not about to stop here...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I grew up here, I trained with Nagi and her team, and everyone showered me with love and affection.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We made the commitment to take up that mantle, and we've been able to come this far!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(So, I know I can surpass her!
No...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
Did you see what she just did...?! That was awesome...!!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Way to go, An!
That was awesome!!!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Nice performance, Kohane!
That was an incredible battle!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, I got so excited that I forgot we were having a battle.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But... I also don't like losing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, An, let's do this again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Next time, I'm going to win.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I'm gonna win again when we do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I can keep being the best partner you could ever ask for!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now I see. It all makes sense now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Sometimes I'll win, sometimes she will.
I'll be in the lead for one minute, and she will the next.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But we'll keep pushing each other forward.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's what I've always wanted. A real partner.)
